arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT")
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL
SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT" < 0 OR i."STAT_CD" NOT IN ('O','P')

SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) AS vk, LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM("INV_NO")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') AS ik, COUNT(*) AS n, ARRAY_AGG("INV_ID") AS ids FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", p."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT", h."SRC_CD" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT" LIMIT 50
SELECT p."PRD_ID", COUNT(*) AS jrnls FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" GROUP BY 1
